content:
Creates a new account group.
Requires ADMINISTRATOR [64] user permissions. See Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
The name of the account group.
Note: Account group names can only contain letters, numbers, and
whitespace.
Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]
An array of account UUIDs to add to the account group.
